recovery.budget_policy: Preserve original task identity, attempt history and consumed compute time; retries receive only the unused original budget.
recovery.ownership_policy: Exclusive ownership of affected source batches and one registered recovery output prevent duplicate replay or budget reset.

rounds.scope_hash_encoding: Sorted case/direction labels, UTF-8 newline separated with a final newline.

output_checks.scope: Checksums verify saved bytes and reference consistency, not a new scientific equality comparison.

overlap.definition: Coordinator claim-to-finish intervals include compute, publication and communication; they establish overlapping task ownership, not CPU saturation.

measurement_limits: Successful compute/publication CPU fields are reported by the child; failed attempts may lack one or both fields.
Sampled CPU is measured between available process samples and may omit work before the first or after the last sample; it is not added to child-reported CPU.
A child exception during publication reports whole-task cpu_seconds and compute_seconds; these are not mislabeled as compute-only measurements.
Phase RSS maxima are retained, but the runtime stores only an overall sample count, not per-phase sample counts.
Zero-sample and unobserved-phase values remain missing, not zero-memory claims.
Process lifetime RSS peaks, when present, include earlier work in a persistent worker; task phase RSS is reported separately.
Raw range verification does not deserialize large decoded results or rerun decoding.

allocation_resources.accounting: Parent allocation CPU counted once; step totals cross-checked, not added.

original_failure_scope.scope_hash_encoding: UTF-8 sorted case/direction labels separated by newlines, with a final newline.

measurement_scope.sampling: Periodic RSS samples plus phase-boundary observations; process lifetime high-water marks are labelled separately.
measurement_scope.timing: Diagnostic CPU and elapsed times are not controlled speed comparisons. Other local diagnostic or recovery work overlapped some measurements.
measurement_scope.ownership_limit: RSS includes allocator residency and cannot be read as exact live-object ownership.
measurement_scope.publication: Protocol-5 binary publication through the maintained gzip bundle writer; no expanded JSON export.
measurement_scope.sample_interval_scope: The 0.1-second interval describes local diagnostic probes. Recovery attempt metrics separately record a 0.2-second interval.

measurement_definitions.inventory_rss_bytes: Boundary sample after unique-fragment inventory construction.
measurement_definitions.pre_record_rss_bytes: Boundary sample after decoder preparation, before local table/record construction.
measurement_definitions.record_built_rss_bytes: Boundary sample with the completed saved event record.
measurement_definitions.adapter_returned_rss_bytes: Boundary sample after production decoding adapter return.
measurement_definitions.publication_peak_rss_bytes: Maximum observed during binary serialization and durable bundle publication.
measurement_definitions.record_fields: Entry/reference counts, not unique-object counts; null means not measured.

repair_scope: Release export-only family/partition working tables after recording them.
Create joint-evaluation arrays only when evaluation is requested.
Share equal saved atom-domain/action metadata and immutable tuple values without merging scientific alternatives.
Restore equal immutable catalogue mappings, required edges and ordered actions through shared storage.

final_cold_validation.scope: Fresh process; production decoding, full saved-record export and actual binary publication.

persistent_mac_validation.scope: One persistent production Workspace; release each output after publication; no explicit collection or cache/session clearing between tasks.
persistent_mac_validation.conclusion: Cold-process success does not establish persistent-worker safety under the same guard.

lifetime_diagnostic.scope: Separate two-catalogue boundary diagnostic; the second case stopped before record construction and was not decoded to completion.
lifetime_diagnostic.interpretation: Observed object release does not imply that Python or the system allocator returns all resident memory.

comparisons.comparison_scope: Retained baseline and final catalogue-sharing repaired outputs, restored in a separate diagnostic process.

Reconstructed the exact pre-repair constructor, table cache and export methods in an isolated process; used the value-identical current catalogue loader and unchanged scientific helpers; compared against the retained final repaired output.

exact_saved_value_comparisons.scope: Full typed-result and saved-record equality, including every nested container type, value and order.

test_validation.scope: Affected suites plus smoke checks; no full-suite rerun and no new matching benchmark.

runs.scope_note: Before final campaign ownership and registration changes.

test_validation.independent_oracles: Retained event tests cover correlated actions, preserved constraints, cut provenance, alternative partitions and unmatched boundaries; catalogue transport tests preserve ordered mapping choices.

limitations: All 84 original decoding memory failures were recovered under 2 GiB across three explicit recovery rounds; historical failed attempts remain preserved.
The cold and persistent Mac diagnostics and five-case Linux validation are not a fixed memory bound for all catalogues.
The five-case persistent Mac sequence used b8c923e; its fifth case failed during table construction. That sequence was not rerun under 940edab.
The complete value comparisons establish exactness only for their stated saved inputs; the 940edab comparison applies the declared v4-to-v5 projection.
No throughput or speedup claim follows from these overlapping diagnostic runs.
Earlier successful recovery outputs retain their generating revisions; the seven third-round outputs use mappa.decoded_events/v5.

task_local_session_diagnostic.scope: In-process diagnostic of earlier decoder-session release; no production algorithm change or claimed recovery result.
task_local_session_diagnostic.conclusion: Task-local session release preserved the first saved result exactly and reduced RSS after its release, but did not keep the subsequent 37270 decode within the same persistent-process 2 GiB guard. No production change is justified as a sufficient fix by this experiment.

linux_persistent_validation.per_case_peak_definition: Maximum RSS sampled by the 100ms external supervisor for this case; lifetime OS high-water reported separately
linux_persistent_validation.timing_scope: Instrumented production adapter and BundleWriter publication; not an uninstrumented baseline performance comparison

changes: Share equal internal and boundary group records, preserving their region and exact shared terms.
additional_export_sharing.timing_scope: Single instrumented runs; the 0.78% compute difference is not a controlled speed comparison.
additional_export_sharing.saved_container_scope: Exact sharing applied to a previously saved output, measured separately from the production replay.

changes: Restore equal immutable branch atom tuples and fragment-pair tuples with shared storage, preserving order, all branches, provenance and independent mutable owners.
Export schema mappa.decoded_events/v5 omits derived table atom_domains and atom_actions maps. Runtime maps and scientific event calculations remain unchanged.
The saved original catalogue, ordered actions, constraints, local term responses, action bindings, partitions and occupancy-boundary metadata remain present.
compact_export_repair.interface_change: Consumers requiring the removed v4 fields must derive them from the saved catalogue or query runtime tables. No legacy export mode or algorithm fallback was added.

limits: These stopped ownership probes are not completed decoding runs or recovery attempts.
Atom-map container bytes exclude referenced tuple values and temporary audit indexes.
RSS after restoration includes retained allocator space and must not be equated with unique live catalogue bytes.
The catalogue ownership walk was bounded and incomplete; per-field duplicate container counts are not additive across fields.

local_catalogue_diagnostic.measurement: Unique owned tuple containers compared with distinct exact values; not an observed RSS saving.

compact_export_repair.independent_validation: Saved local response records were checked against the existing independent scalar event oracle, including ordered/correlated choices, cuts, partial occupancy, unmatched boundaries and metal thresholds.

cold_production_validation.scope: One cold instrumented decode; no simultaneous local scientific benchmark.
cold_production_validation.timing_limit: Single instrumented cold runs, not a controlled throughput comparison.

shared_preparation_repair.scope: Decoder preparation only. Existing matching, reduction, campaign outputs and reference verification were not repeated or changed.
changes: Reuse exact saved action programs and their hashes.
Reuse final reachable target sets and ordered dependencies across family witnesses.
Retain sparse moved-atom orbits and interpretation-owned subsequences; no prefix histories or complete working-table retention.
Preserve the v5 schema, family constraints, cut annotations, correlated choices and saved order.

preparation_retention.note: The byte allowance accounts tuple storage, not total Python/process memory; independent production guard remains2GiB.

critical_checks: Unique program/image preparation across distinct family constraints and partitions.
Independent scalar events for correlated and ordered actions, cuts and required constraints.
Preparation release across repeated session use; bounded retention and exact recomputation after eviction.

limitations: Single cold measured run per version, not a repeated statistical speed estimate.
Persistent worker measurements use five approved local catalogues, not a cluster throughput measurement.
Other four saved comparisons use the previously declared v4-to-v5 projection; this repair itself changes no saved fields.
The completed full EnzymeMap campaign retains its documented generating revisions.
